description: Opt-in add-on: automerge Ignition-related dependencies after the standard quarantine. Not part of the default preset since not every project tracks Ignition. A repo that wants this extends both presets.

packageRules.description: Ignition-related deps (the platform image, ignition-api-stubs, bwdesigngroup/ignition-docker, etc.) track upstream after the standard quarantine. Patch only for now, since 8.x moves mostly at the 8.3.x level; minor still needs review. This will need a rework once Ignition moves to its year-based version scheme (2027.x.x).
